version.promotional_text: Spot the fork. Find the mate. Survive the streak. 53,000 puzzles from real games that get harder as you get better. Pawn today, King someday.
version.description:
Think you can see three moves ahead? Prove it.

King Walk throws real chess puzzles at you, 53,000 of them, pulled from actual games. Solve one and the next gets tougher. Miss one and it backs off. A few dozen puzzles in, it knows exactly how good you are. Then it starts pushing.

You start as a Pawn. Earn Knight, Bishop, Rook and Queen. Reach King and you've walked the whole board.

• 53,000 puzzles from real games: forks, pins, skewers and sneaky back-rank mates
• A rating that finds your level and climbs with you
• A daily puzzle, the same for everyone. Keep the streak alive, brag in emoji
• Rank streaks: 15 puzzles, no hints, one miss and you're out
• Challenge friends in Game Center and settle who's actually good
• Stuck? Take a hint. We won't tell anyone.
• Missed one? It comes back later for a rematch
• Big, loud celebrations every time you rank up
• Widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy
• A daily reminder, if you want one
• Haptics, dark mode, VoiceOver and larger text
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases

The puzzles come from the public-domain Lichess puzzle database. King Walk is not made or endorsed by Lichess.

review_notes:
King Walk is a single-player chess puzzle game. No account, no login, no in-app purchases, no ads, no user-generated content, no chat. A video of the app in use is attached.

PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
For anyone who wants to get better at chess tactics, from beginners to club players. Each puzzle is a position from a real game with one best line. A puzzle rating follows the player's level, and the next puzzles are chosen near it.

HOW TO USE IT (no setup needed)
- Launch the app; the first puzzle is ready. Tap a piece, then tap where it goes (or drag it).
- Hint shows the piece to move, then where it goes. Answer plays the solution. Then Next puzzle.
- The calendar button at the top opens the daily puzzle, the same for everyone each day.
- Settings (the gear): sound, haptics, an optional daily reminder (a local notification), Game Center, help and credits.

WHAT THE APP ADDS ON iOS
Game Center leaderboards, achievements and challenges; Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets; a Control Center control and a Siri action; iCloud sync of progress; haptics; layouts for iPhone Duo.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
None are needed to play: all 53,000 puzzles are bundled, so it works offline. Optional: Game Center and iCloud key-value storage (Apple), and GoatCounter, which receives anonymous event counts with no personal data and no cookies. Each puzzle links to its page on lichess.org, which opens in Safari.

REGIONS
The app works the same in every region, in 44 languages that follow the device's language.

REGULATION AND THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not a regulated industry. The puzzles come from the Lichess puzzle database, released into the public domain (CC0): https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles. The app is not made or endorsed by Lichess and says so in its credits. Chess rules: chess.js (BSD license). Fonts: Fredoka, Nunito, Rubik, Baloo 2 family, M PLUS Rounded 1c and Mitr (SIL Open Font License). The pieces, icon and artwork are original.
